verses.html: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.text: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.html: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.text: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

verses.html: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.text: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.html: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

verses.html: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.text: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.html: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
verses.text: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

verses.html: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.html: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.text: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

verses.html: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.html: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.text: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
